subject: Post-demo commercial pathing: marketplace activation vs. PO/card
body:
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo commercial pathing: marketplace activation vs. PO/card

Ethan / Sarah — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can map procurement to an activation plan.

Call highlights (30-min demo):
- Your pilots are focused on clinical summarization and triage routing (API usage pattern: bursts, many short requests).
- Security/compliance will require audit logs retained for 1 year and KMS integration for keys.
- Initial consumption estimate: ~4M tokens/month in pilot.

Commercial options discussed:
1) AWS Marketplace (bring your own commitment) — fast procurement for legal team; invoice via AWS; eligible for consolidated invoicing and existing SSO/Billing relationships.
2) Direct PO (Redwood invoice to Aurora) — supports your internal PO workflow and existing vendor onboarding; we can provide required procurement docs and net-30 terms for pilots.
3) Card (self-serve) — fastest to start but harder for audit/finance to reconcile for pilots of this size.

Open questions for procurement readiness (please flag any that your team needs):
- Does Aurora prefer marketplace billing for pilots (leveraging existing AWS relationship) or a direct vendor PO?
- Who is the procurement owner / billing contact (name, email, phone, and whether they need vendor onboarding packet)?
- Any mandatory security paperwork beyond SOC 2 (e.g., data processing addendum, specific encryption standards)?

Attachments I’m sharing: marketplace activation options (PDF) and an estimated MAP workbook for pilot billing scenarios.

Suggested next steps:
- If marketplace is preferred: we can draft the AWS listing activation steps and share a minimal vendor disclosure doc for your procurement team (timeline: ~5 business days to enable listing once info received).
- If direct PO: we'll push a procurement packet and SOW template (attached) for your legal / procurement to review; primary turnaround is usually 7–10 business days.

Can you confirm procurement preference and the contact for onboarding? I’ll loop in Solutions (Marissa) to start tech enablement once billing route is picked.

Thanks — Ben

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0128
[Attachment: redwood-marketplace-activation-options.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Aurora-MAP-draft.xlsx (xlsx)]

---

From: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@aurorahealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo commercial pathing: marketplace activation vs. PO/card

Ben — appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers below:

- Procurement preference: leaning toward AWS Marketplace to keep billing under our cloud contract, but procurement/legal want to validate vendor profile and pricing cadence.
- Procurement owner: Sarah Kim (cc’d) — she handles vendor onboarding and will need the vendor packet + SOC 2 evidence and DPA.
- Card vs PO: card is out for this pilot (internal policy). PO preferred but if marketplace can route through our AWS relationship and show the right invoice format, that will be easier.

We have an internal vendor questionnaire that our security team will push; Sarah — I’ll kick that to you after this thread.

Next steps from our side: Sarah will let you know the vendor packet checklist and timeline (we’re aiming for a pilot start in early Oct).

Thanks,
Ethan

---

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo commercial pathing: marketplace activation vs. PO/card

Perfect — thanks Ethan. Sarah, copying you directly to get the onboarding checklist and any preferred templates. Two quick notes to make procurement’s life easier: 

1) Marketplace path specifics:
   - We can publish a private listing (if you want purchase by ARN) or make a standard listing tied to your AWS account.
   - Invoices appear through AWS and roll up under your existing invoice stream — we will confirm invoice line-item format to match your AP needs.

2) Direct PO path specifics:
   - We’ll provide a Redwood vendor packet (W-9, SOC 2, DPA, commercial terms) and a SOW/Statement-of-Work draft that your legal can redline.

I’ll schedule a short 20-minute procurement intake call for this Thursday or Friday to walk Sarah through both options and collect the vendor questionnaire details. Proposed times: Thu 9/16 at 10:00am PT or Fri 9/17 at 8:00am PT — what works best?

Also looping Marissa for technical enablement planning once billing route and contract path are chosen. Priyom — can you prepare a one-page note on expected token usage patterns and any recommended quantization/instance profiles for the pilot? That will help procurement understand unit economics.

Best,
Ben

[Attachment: SOW_template.docx (docx)]

---

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@aurorahealth.com>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo commercial pathing: marketplace activation vs. PO/card

Hi Sarah / Ethan — Marissa here from Solutions. Thanks for the heads up on procurement preference — happy to join the intake call and walk through technical requirements that procurement/security may ask about (audit log retention, KMS, VPC connectivity for Private mode).

For the call we’ll bring the following artifacts:
- Short technical one-pager (expected tokens, latency SLOs, recommended instance classes)
- Marketplace activation checklist (items needed to publish a listing)
- Example invoice line item layout for AWS Marketplace

Sarah — if you can share your vendor questionnaire ahead of the call that would be great. I’ll also include a terse pilot SOW (1 page) to speed PO review.

Proposed intake call times (confirm): Thu 2027-09-16 10:00am PT — we’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0199

[Attachment: technical-one-pager.pdf (pdf)]
